bottlenecks.method: Phase bottlenecks are ranked only by retained wall-clock medians. This is observational attribution to an instrumented phase, not a CPU/flamegraph or storage-device causal attribution.

claim_boundary.causality: The data identifies expensive instrumented phases but cannot prove which CPU instruction, filesystem operation, cache state, or device is causal.
claim_boundary.cold_unprimed: The label means no harness prime checkpoint; it does not mean operating-system page cache or CPU caches were reset.
claim_boundary.cross_release: The 49.2271104608x v1-to-v2 ratio is one historical signed observation per release only. It is not a statistical speedup, candidate speedup, universal speedup, or causal decomposition of an optimization.
claim_boundary.host_scope: All 100 profile observations come from one four-physical-core host fingerprint. No cross-machine distribution or inferential performance result is claimed.
claim_boundary.internal_timing: Executor phase timings and standalone reference_replay_ns are product/self-reported monotonic timings cross-checked against harness records; external process wall timings come from the harness observer.
claim_boundary.oversubscription: The 8- and 16-lane cells are oversubscribed configurations on four physical cores, not 8-core or 16-core performance results.
claim_boundary.primary_execution: primary_execution_ns includes lane-pool setup, arithmetic, checkpoint-piece encoding, durable write/sync, and receipt commit; it is not a compute-only timer.
claim_boundary.residual: Admission has no dedicated timer. admission_and_coordination_residual_ns is exactly end_to_end - execution - finalization - verification and includes admission/ingestion plus uninstrumented checkpoint coordination, receipt scans, I/O-account aggregation, and pre-timestamp result assembly. Post-timestamp result-structure validation, unlock, and CLI work are outside internal end-to-end.
claim_boundary.supercomputer_designation: This is a profile of a signed software-defined local executor on the measured host; it does not establish a hardware-class or institutional supercomputer designation.

method.cell_median: For each 10-observation cell, sort integer nanoseconds and take the arithmetic mean of positions 5 and 6. Half-nanosecond medians are retained exactly as decimal strings.
method.executor_phase_partition: Four exclusive components are used: admission/coordination residual, primary execution, finalization, and embedded exact replay. Their raw value sums exactly to internal end-to-end for every observation.
method.filtering: none; all 100 retained successful v3 outcomes are included
method.phase_share: share_of_sum_of_phase_medians_percent divides each exact phase median by the sum of the four exact phase medians. median_per_observation_share_percent is the median of each observation's phase/end-to-end percentage.
method.standalone_partition: Standalone external wall is partitioned into product-reported reference replay and an external non-replay residual. This process is separate from executor internal end-to-end and is never included in executor phase shares.
